Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when hit by abilities in succession and then explodes, so it is important to dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame, his first poke. If you are ablaze, get out of the line of Brand Q Sear or stand behind minions to avoid the stun. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast, spread out from allies to prevent it from bouncing.
Brand.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand Brand’s damage. Brand P Blaze scales with your max health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health on their own. If you keep getting caught by immobilizing effects right after engaging, get Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Brand.fight: Close the distance with Gragas E Body Slam when Brand W Pillar of Flame is on cooldown and you are not ablaze. Activate Gragas W Drunken Rage before Brand’s burst hits to reduce the damage you take. Gragas’s magic damage is effective against Brand, who has low magic resistance.
Brand.laning: Do not last-hit beside burning minions, and step aside if the wave catches fire. If approaching through the jungle, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll in Brand’s retreat path first, then knock him up with Gragas E Body Slam as he backs away.
Brand.combo: Cast Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot while dashing with Gragas E Body Slam. Once E hits and Brand is airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage and recast Q to detonate it. When needed, land Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Brand to knock him toward your allies.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so the moment after Brand W Pillar of Flame is used is your chance to engage. If you are ablaze, watch for the stun from Brand Q Sear; once the fire goes out, engage with Gragas E Body Slam.
Brand.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out from allies to reduce the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the bounces of Brand R Pyroclasm. Activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, knock up the back line with Gragas E Body Slam, then detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask between the front and back lines to split the formation, and engage within a distance your allies can follow.
Brand.phase: Gragas’s burst damage peaks in the mid game as ability power items stack up, so look for opportunities when Brand’s poke abilities are down. In the late game, focus on burst damage and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.

Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, you will be stunned and let Amumu engage, so dodge with minions or jungle monsters between you. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns enemies in an area, so keep your distance before Amumu closes in and do not group with allies. After being caught, create distance again so you do not take Amumu W Despair’s max-health-based damage for long.
Amumu.build: If engaging puts you in a position to be immediately caught by Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, get Quicksilver Sash earlier. Build magic resistance against Amumu’s magic damage, and avoid choices that add a lot of health on their own because of Amumu W Despair. Amumu P Cursed Touch’s true damage cannot be reduced by magic resistance.
Amumu.fight: Engage with Gragas E Body Slam after dodging Amumu Q Bandage Toss or once Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll while he is airborne and add damage with Gragas W Drunken Rage’s empowered basic attack. When Amumu gets close and starts dealing damage, adjust your distance instead of fighting him for long.
Amumu.laning: In lane, stand behind minions and move unpredictably to make it harder for Amumu to engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss. When ganking as Gragas, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll in the opponent’s retreat path first, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they back away.
Amumu.combo: Cast Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot while dashing with Gragas E Body Slam. If Gragas E Body Slam hits, press Gragas W Drunken Rage while the target is airborne, then detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll. If you need to move Amumu toward your allies, land Gragas R Explosive Cask behind him.
Amumu.phase: Gragas has strong burst in mid game; in late game, focus on burst and disrupting formations over sustained damage.
Amumu.teamfight: If Amumu has Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, spread out from allies and fight in open terrain. Once Amumu’s stun abilities are down and your allies are within range to follow up, activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, engage with Gragas E Body Slam, and follow with Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Land Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy front and back lines to split their formation.
Amumu.escape: When Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down, that’s your window to engage with Gragas E Body Slam. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so after you land Gragas E Body Slam, he’ll struggle to get away without using Flash. If you miss Gragas E Body Slam, you’ll have to wait a long time before using it again, so engage when you have a clear shot.

Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush stuns and reduces armor and magic resistance, so dodge the charge. When Briar E Chilling Scream begins charging, interrupt it with Gragas E Body Slam, and do not fight with your back to a wall where a fully charged scream can knock you into it. If hit by Briar R Certain Death, group up with your allies and fight back together instead of fleeing alone.
Briar.build: Build armor first against Briar’s main damage. Briar E Chilling Scream and Briar R Certain Death deal magic damage, so armor alone cannot block them. If the duel goes long, consider Grievous Wounds after getting resistances.
Briar.fight: When Briar dives in with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, stand in front to keep her from reaching your back-line damage dealers. When Briar charges Briar E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with the knock-up from Gragas E Body Slam to prevent her healing and wall stun. After Briar’s dash is spent, close the distance with Gragas E Body Slam and fight.
Briar.laning: Watch for Briar’s early ganks and avoid staying in the middle of the lane for long when you lack vision. If you push the lane and establish vision, you may get a chance to counterattack Briar’s reckless engage. As Gragas, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll in the opponent’s retreat path, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they back away to gank.
Briar.combo: Place Gragas Q Barrel Roll in Briar’s approach path first, then knock her up with Gragas E Body Slam when she closes in. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to move Briar toward your allies or block her escape route.
Briar.escape: Do not engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down. She can still move with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and Briar R Certain Death, so look for an opening especially before Briar R Certain Death comes back up. Engage when you can interrupt Briar E Chilling Scream’s charge with Gragas E Body Slam.
Briar.phase: Briar has high kill participation early, so watch for ganks, but her reckless engages can also create chances to counterattack. Gragas has strong burst in mid game; in late game, focus on burst and disrupting formations over sustained damage.
Briar.teamfight: While Briar is in Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, she chases the nearest enemy, so stand in front to protect your back-line damage dealers. Position so the front line is hit first by the bloodstone from Briar R Certain Death as well. Engage within a distance your allies can follow: activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, chain Gragas E Body Slam into Gragas Q Barrel Roll, then split the enemy formation with Gragas R Explosive Cask.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies and leaves a mark, so dodge sideways instead of retreating in a straight line. If marked, create distance because Diana E Lunar Rush can dive in again. Do not approach right after Diana activates Diana W Pale Cascade; wait until its orbs and shield are gone.
Diana.build: First, secure enough movement speed to get out of the warned attack area. If building resistance against Diana’s damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
Diana.fight: After dodging Diana Q Crescent Strike, close the distance with Gragas E Body Slam while Diana E Lunar Rush is down. Start trading after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear. If Diana looks ready to burst, use Gragas W Drunken Rage in advance.
Diana.laning: Gragas Q Barrel Roll deals reduced damage to minions, so save it for fights instead of farming.
Diana.combo: Cast Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot while dashing with Gragas E Body Slam. Once Gragas E Body Slam hits and Diana is airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage, detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll, then follow with an empowered basic attack. When needed, land Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Diana to knock her toward your allies.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, counterattack with Gragas E Body Slam as soon as that mobility spell is down. Use the slow from Gragas Q Barrel Roll to keep her in range, and, if needed, move her to the desired spot with Gragas R Explosive Cask. If you are marked, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so do not engage and create distance instead.
Diana.phase: Gragas lacks sustained damage in late game, so focus on burst and disrupting formations.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out from allies based on Diana’s angle of approach so multiple allies are not pulled in by Diana R Moonfall. Secure vision on the flank approach, and counterattack when Diana engages with Gragas E Body Slam and Gragas R Explosive Cask. Before engaging, make sure your allies can follow, then use Gragas R Explosive Cask to split the enemy front and back lines.

Ekko.watch: When you see Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s signal, stay out of the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Also move out of the path of Ekko Q Timewinder as it returns. If you see Ekko’s afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t overcommit to chasing even when health is low.
Ekko.build: Build magic resistance first to reduce damage from Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, Ekko Q Timewinder, and Ekko W Parallel Convergence. Watch for getting caught in Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun and hit by his combo. If you can’t use Gragas E Body Slam, prioritize tenacity over magic resistance.
Ekko.fight: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, he has no movement ability available, so look for a chance to knock him up with Gragas E Body Slam. However, if Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, he can escape, so commit after he uses R. If you see Ekko’s burst coming, use Gragas W Drunken Rage beforehand.
Ekko.laning: In the jungle, clear camps with Gragas W Drunken Rage’s empowered attack and stay healthy with Gragas P Happy Hour’s healing when you use abilities. When ganking, circle behind the lane and place Gragas Q Barrel Roll on Ekko’s retreat path, then knock him up with Gragas E Body Slam as he backs away.
Ekko.combo: While dashing with Gragas E Body Slam, roll Gragas Q Barrel Roll to the landing spot. When E hits and Ekko is airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage and detonate Q. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Ekko to send him toward your allies when needed.
Ekko.escape: Avoid the stun area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence and engage during the window when Ekko E Phase Dive and Ekko R Chronobreak are unavailable. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, he can still escape with R, so don’t rush in. Before R comes back, close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam and disrupt his movement with Gragas R Explosive Cask.
Ekko.phase: In the mid game, Gragas’s burst is strongest with one or two ability power items, so look for an opening after Ekko R Chronobreak is used. In the late game, focus on burst damage and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
Ekko.teamfight: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, interrupt his movement with Gragas E Body Slam or Gragas R Explosive Cask. Before engaging, check for Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s signal and whether Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, and make sure your allies are close enough to follow up. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to split the enemy front and back lines, giving your allies time to clear the frontline.

Elise.watch: When Elise transforms with Elise R Spider Form after health has dropped, it signals an attempt to finish off the target, so be ready to use Gragas E Body Slam or W Drunken Rage.
Elise.build: Build magic resistance first to reduce damage from Elise’s main abilities. Also get armor to reduce her basic attack damage, and consider tenacity if the stun from Elise E Cocoon is a problem.
Elise.fight: Engage with Gragas E Body Slam after Elise E Cocoon and Elise R Spider Form E Rappel are used. Elise tends to have low magic resistance, so make sure your damage lands by detonating Gragas Q Barrel Roll while she is airborne from E.
Elise.laning: Place plenty of vision to prevent Elise’s early ganks, and don’t push the lane too far when she’s out of sight. When ganking, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll on the enemy’s retreat path, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they back away.
Elise.combo: Once Elise E Cocoon and Elise R Spider Form E Rappel are both spent, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot while dashing in with Gragas E Body Slam. When E hits and Elise is airborne, press W Drunken Rage, detonate Q, then follow up with an empowered basic attack. If you need to reposition her, land Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Elise to knock her toward your allies.
Elise.escape: Right after Elise uses Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite is a chance to close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam. If you’ve confirmed that Elise E Cocoon and Elise R Spider Form E Rappel are also down, engage back into her, and use Gragas R Explosive Cask to cut off her escape route if needed.
Elise.phase: In the early game, focus on not giving up kills while watching for Elise’s ganks. In the mid game, make use of Gragas’s burst, and in the late game, focus on burst damage and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
Elise.teamfight: Before engaging, check whether Elise E Cocoon is down and whether your allies are close enough to follow up. Activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, then engage with E Body Slam and follow up with Q Barrel Roll. Land R Explosive Cask between the enemy front and back lines to split their formation.

Evelynn.watch: When you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, back away before the charm lands. Evelynn E Whiplash, which follows the charm, deals damage based on your maximum health, so place Gragas Q Barrel Roll on her expected approach path and leave room to retreat. When you’re low on health, Evelynn R Last Caress deals much more damage, so don’t stay where you lack vision.
Evelynn.build: Get a Control Ward first to secure vision at the spot where Evelynn might start a fight. Build magic resistance to reduce damage from her main abilities, but prioritize backing away before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures, since it reduces your resistances.
Evelynn.fight: While the mark from Evelynn W Allure is maturing, create distance instead of fighting back. Right after Evelynn engages, knock her up with Gragas E Body Slam and detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll. If you see her burst coming, use Gragas W Drunken Rage beforehand.
Evelynn.laning: When ganking, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll on the enemy’s retreat path, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam.
Evelynn.combo: While dashing with Gragas E Body Slam, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot and detonate it while the enemy is airborne. If Gragas E Body Slam hits, press Gragas W Drunken Rage to follow up with an empowered basic attack. When Evelynn R Last Caress is unavailable, use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock Evelynn toward your allies.
Evelynn.escape: Don’t engage just because Evelynn E Whiplash is down. Look for an opening before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back, close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam, and disrupt her escape route with Gragas R Explosive Cask.
Evelynn.phase: In the late game, focus on burst damage and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn targets backline damage dealers, so stay within your allies’ vision, protect your carries, and save Gragas E Body Slam. If Evelynn engages, knock her up with Gragas E Body Slam and follow up with Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock Evelynn toward your allies or split the enemy formation.

Fiddlesticks.watch: If you see Fiddlesticks channeling Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, interrupt him with Gragas E Body Slam or Gragas R Explosive Cask. If you can’t interrupt him, move out of range and wait out the duration. If Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a long time, watch for an ambush from a bush and don’t walk past an unchecked Scarecrow Effigy.
Fiddlesticks.build: Build movement speed first so you can leave the telegraphed area of effect. Build magic resistance to reduce damage from Fiddlesticks. If you’re getting caught by Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and the silence from Fiddlesticks E Reap, then hit by Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm for a long time, prioritize tenacity as well.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Clear camps with Gragas W Drunken Rage’s empowered basic attack, and cycle your abilities to make use of Gragas P Happy Hour’s healing. When ganking, circle behind the lane, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll on the enemy’s retreat path, and knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam. Keep vision in the bushes behind the lane to watch for Fiddlesticks’s ambush.
Fiddlesticks.combo: While dashing with Gragas E Body Slam, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot. When Gragas E Body Slam hits and Fiddlesticks is airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage and detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll. If you need to move Fiddlesticks toward your allies, use Gragas R Explosive Cask behind him.
Fiddlesticks.escape: Check whether Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is down before closing in with Gragas E Body Slam. If you need to interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest after engaging, save Gragas R Explosive Cask for it.
Fiddlesticks.phase: In the mid game, Gragas’s burst is strongest, so look for an opening while Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is unavailable. In the late game, focus on burst damage and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, Fiddlesticks E Reap, and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm all deal area damage, so spread out from your allies and don’t bunch up in narrow areas without vision. If you see Fiddlesticks casting Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, interrupt him with Gragas E Body Slam or Gragas R Explosive Cask. Before engaging, check that Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is down and your allies can follow up, then use Gragas R Explosive Cask to split the enemy formation.

Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks back farther the greater the distance he has run, so when Hecarim turns and starts running, break vision or move closer to your allies. Spread out during teamfights so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows does not fear multiple teammates.
Hecarim.build: Hecarim’s main damage, Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge, is physical, so build armor first. Hecarim W Spirit of Dread and Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows deal magic damage, which armor cannot block.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, slow Hecarim first with Gragas Q Barrel Roll to reduce his approach and damage. If you see Hecarim’s burst coming, use Gragas W Drunken Rage in advance.
Hecarim.laning: Gragas can use an ability at each camp to make use of Gragas P Happy Hour’s healing, and look for gank angles where Gragas E Body Slam can connect.
Hecarim.combo: Place Gragas Q Barrel Roll on Hecarim’s retreat path first, then knock him up with Gragas E Body Slam as he tries to back away. While he is airborne after being hit, use Gragas W Drunken Rage and detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll. When needed, use Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Hecarim to knock him toward your allies.
Hecarim.escape: Do not engage just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge alone has been expended. Look for an opening before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back, close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam, and cut off his escape route with Gragas R Explosive Cask.
Hecarim.phase: In the late game, focus on short bursts and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
Hecarim.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t hit multiple people. When Hecarim engages, slow him with Gragas Q Barrel Roll and knock him up with Gragas E Body Slam to stop his approach. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation.

Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so do not fight with a wall at your back or in a narrow jungle passage. Graves W Smoke Screen blocks vision and slows you, so leave its area by the shortest route, then re-engage. Graves P New Destiny’s basic attack damage is blocked by the first unit hit, so keep minions or an ally between you and Graves.
Graves.build: Graves’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Getting Plated Steelcaps early helps in early and mid-game skirmishes. Keep in mind that armor does not block the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen.
Graves.fight: While Graves reloads after firing two shots, close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam and look to trade. Fight in open terrain where you have room to dodge Graves Q End of the Line’s explosion, and activate Gragas W Drunken Rage before taking damage. If Gragas E Body Slam misses, you will have little way to disengage, so engage when you have a clear angle to hit.
Graves.laning: Gragas can clear camps with empowered basic attacks from Gragas W Drunken Rage, use abilities, and recover health from Gragas P Happy Hour. Rather than clearing every camp, look for gank angles where Gragas E Body Slam can connect from early on and limit Graves’s time to scale. When ganking, circle behind the enemy and place Gragas Q Barrel Roll on their retreat path.
Graves.combo: Place Gragas Q Barrel Roll on Graves’s retreat path first, then knock him up with Gragas E Body Slam as he backs away. While he is airborne after being hit, press Gragas W Drunken Rage and recast Gragas Q Barrel Roll to detonate it. To send Graves toward your allies with Gragas R Explosive Cask, aim the explosion behind him.
Graves.escape: Do not engage immediately just because Graves E Quickdraw is on cooldown. If Graves R Collateral Damage is also down and has not returned yet, close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam and look for a chance to displace him with Gragas R Explosive Cask.
Graves.phase: Graves gets stronger over time, so slow his growth early. In the late game, Gragas should focus on burst damage and disrupting formations.
Graves.teamfight: When fighting Graves, keep minions or an ally between you and him to block Graves P New Destiny’s basic attacks, and watch for Graves Q End of the Line near walls. Within a distance your allies can follow up, activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, knock up the backline with Gragas E Body Slam, then follow with Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Drop Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation.

Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller roots you, Ivern’s allies can dash in, so avoid its angle by keeping minions or terrain between you and Ivern. Before engaging with Gragas E Body Slam, check whether Ivern E Triggerseed has detonated and left a slow. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, reposition to avoid being knocked up by consecutive attacks.
Ivern.build: Against Ivern, the paths that let allies follow up on Ivern Q Rootcaller’s root and Ivern R Daisy!’s knockup are more dangerous, so consider tenacity first. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance over armor, and also consider movement speed to get out of telegraphed areas.
Ivern.fight: Close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam right after Ivern Q Rootcaller misses or is used. Do not engage a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed until the shield detonates. Gragas’s magic damage is effective against Ivern, who tends to have low magic resistance, but do not chase too deep.
Ivern.laning: Early on, ward Ivern’s jungle to track when he comes to harvest camps he has seeded. Gragas can use an ability at each camp to maintain health with Gragas P Happy Hour, and frequently look for gank angles where Gragas E Body Slam can connect. When ganking, circle behind the lane and place Gragas Q Barrel Roll on the enemy’s retreat path.
Ivern.combo: For a gank, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll on the retreat path first, then knock the enemy up with Gragas E Body Slam as they back away and detonate Q. If you have an angle to engage immediately, place Q at the landing spot while dashing with E, then detonate it while the enemy is airborne after E hits. Press Gragas W Drunken Rage right after E hits to follow with an empowered basic attack, and use Gragas R Explosive Cask to move the enemy toward your allies.
Ivern.escape: The window to engage with Gragas E Body Slam is when Ivern Q Rootcaller misses or right after he uses it. If the target is already affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, engage after the shield detonates. E has a long cooldown if it misses, so make sure you have an angle to hit before going in.
Ivern.phase: In the late game, focus on burst damage and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
Ivern.teamfight: If Ivern R Daisy! is blocking the way, do not cast skillshots at enemies behind her. Activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, knock up the backline with E Body Slam, then follow with Q Barrel Roll, but make sure your allies can follow up. Drop Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation.

JarvanIV.watch: If you see burst damage coming, press Gragas W Drunken Rage in advance to reduce the damage.
JarvanIV.laning: Gragas looks to gank by circling behind the enemy, placing Gragas Q Barrel Roll on their retreat path, and knocking them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they back away.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Before engaging, check that your allies are close enough to follow up. Activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, then pin down the enemy backline with Gragas E Body Slam and Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Drop Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation.

Karthus.watch: If you step into Karthus W Wall of Pain, your magic resistance is reduced and you are slowed, making the follow-up Karthus Q Lay Waste and R Requiem hurt more. Move outside the wall, and walk out of the warning area for Karthus Q Lay Waste. Even just after killing Karthus, use Gragas E Body Slam to move away from his corpse and dodge his abilities while he is in spirit form.
Karthus.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can dodge Karthus W Wall of Pain and quickly leave the area of Karthus E Defile. All of Karthus’s damage is magic, so build magic resistance, but keep in mind that stepping into the wall reduces it.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no way to create distance, so engage from an angle where Gragas E Body Slam can reach him. Close in while avoiding the warning area for Karthus Q Lay Waste, and detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll while Karthus is airborne and unable to move.
Karthus.laning: In the jungle, Gragas deals damage with W Drunken Rage and restores health with P Happy Hour while frequently looking for gank angles where E Body Slam can reach.
Karthus.combo: Cast Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point while dashing with E Body Slam. While Karthus is airborne after E hits, press W Drunken Rage and recast Q to detonate it, then land an empowered basic attack. If you need R Explosive Cask, place it behind Karthus to knock him toward your allies.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no mobility or immobilizing abilities, giving you chances to close the distance with Gragas E Body Slam. If Karthus W Wall of Pain has been placed, don’t engage through the wall; find an angle from outside it where E can reach.
Karthus.phase: Disrupt Karthus’s early growth with jungle invades and ganks, using angles where Gragas E Body Slam can reach. Gragas has strong burst in the mid game as you build one or two ability power items, but Karthus catches up quickly if you give him time to farm. In the late game, focus Gragas on burst and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
Karthus.teamfight: Activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, engage with E Body Slam, follow with Q Barrel Roll, and use R Explosive Cask to split Karthus’s backline from his frontline. Even after killing Karthus, damage from his spirit form remains, so move away from his corpse immediately. Engage within a distance your allies can follow, and don’t stay in the area of Karthus E Defile for long.

Jax.watch: Don’t basic attack while Jax E Counter Strike is active; back out of its stun radius. If Jax closes in with Q Leap Strike, watch for the AoE stun from the ensuing Counter Strike, and save Gragas E Body Slam so you can use it to create distance.
Jax.build: Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed are the foundation of his damage, so prioritize considering items that reduce attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance.
Jax.fight: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop empowered basic attacks and get out of its stun radius. Once Counter Strike is down, knock Jax airborne with Gragas E Body Slam and detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll to trade using your abilities.
Jax.combo: Once Jax E Counter Strike is down, dash in with Gragas E Body Slam while placing Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point. While E Body Slam has Jax airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage, detonate Q, then land an empowered basic attack. If you need Gragas R Explosive Cask, place it behind Jax to knock him toward your allies.
Jax.escape: Don’t use Gragas E Body Slam first just because Jax activated E Counter Strike. Use E to get out of Counter Strike’s stun radius, then engage after Jax Q Leap Strike and E Counter Strike are down. You can close the distance with E right after Jax uses Q and reposition him with Gragas R Explosive Cask.
Jax.phase: Gragas has strong burst in the mid game as he builds one or two ability power items, and focuses on burst and disrupting formations in the late game.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax activates E Counter Strike and jumps in, don’t group together. Focus crowd control on him just after the AoE stun ends. Use Gragas E Body Slam and R Explosive Cask to stop Jax’s engage or split the enemy formation. Before engaging, make sure your allies are close enough to follow.

Kayn.watch: Dodge the line hit from Kayn W Blade’s Reach to reduce the risk of being caught by Kayn R Umbral Trespass from long range. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t let trades drag on. If the warning for Kayn E Shadow Step appears at the edge of terrain, stop fighting and retreat toward your turret.
Kayn.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, W Blade’s Reach, and R Umbral Trespass. Stacking health alone also increases the damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash. If he has transformed into the Darkin and the fight is likely to drag on, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances.
Kayn.fight: Dodge Kayn W Blade’s Reach and engage while Kayn R Umbral Trespass is unavailable. You can interrupt Kayn E Shadow Step as he passes through terrain with the airborne effect from Gragas E Body Slam. If Kayn is likely to burst you, use Gragas W Drunken Rage in advance.
Kayn.laning: Kayn is weak early before transforming, so pressure his jungle path and force objectives to delay his transformation. Gragas clears camps with W Drunken Rage and uses the healing from P Happy Hour while looking for gank angles where E Body Slam can reach. When ganking, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy’s escape route first, then knock them airborne with Gragas E Body Slam.
Kayn.combo: As you close in on Kayn, dash with Gragas E Body Slam while placing Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point. While Kayn is airborne after Gragas E Body Slam hits, press Gragas W Drunken Rage, and detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll before Kayn can move. To move Kayn toward your allies with Gragas R Explosive Cask, place it behind him.
Kayn.escape: If only Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down, Kayn can still escape with R Umbral Trespass, so don’t dive in too deep right away. In particular, close the distance with Gragas E Body Slam after dodging Kayn W Blade’s Reach, while Kayn R Umbral Trespass is unavailable. If Kayn escapes with E Shadow Step, look for a chance to interrupt him with the airborne effect from Gragas E Body Slam.
Kayn.phase: Early on, pressure Kayn before he transforms and avoid giving him kills to delay his transformation. Gragas has strong burst in the mid game as he builds one or two ability power items, so actively look for chances to engage then. In the late game, focus on burst and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
Kayn.teamfight: Watch for Kayn to emerge from an ally affected by Kayn R Umbral Trespass, and prepare to knock him airborne with Gragas E Body Slam. When engaging, activate Gragas W Drunken Rage and use Gragas E Body Slam and Q Barrel Roll to lock down the backline. Place Gragas R Explosive Cask between the frontline and backline to split the enemy formation.

Kindred.watch: If Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied to you, create distance or break vision so you don’t take repeated hits. You’re in greater danger at low health, so press Gragas W Drunken Rage before heavy damage lands to reduce the damage you take.
Kindred.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and E Mounting Dread. If the fight is likely to drag on, consider Grievous Wounds next to counter healing from Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy and R Lamb’s Respite.
Kindred.fight: If only Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down, Kindred can still escape with her remaining mobility, so don’t rush your engage. Before Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy comes back, close in with Gragas E Body Slam to knock her airborne, then detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll while she can’t move.
Kindred.laning: In the jungle, maintain your health with empowered basic attacks from Gragas W Drunken Rage and healing from Gragas P Happy Hour while watching lane situations. When ganking, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy’s escape route, then knock them airborne with Gragas E Body Slam as they retreat. Take camps marked with P Mark of the Kindred first or secure vision nearby to delay Kindred from claiming the mark.
Kindred.combo: Before Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy comes back, engage with Gragas E Body Slam while placing Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point. While E hits and knocks Kindred airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage, detonate Q, then land an empowered basic attack. If needed, place Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Kindred to knock her toward your allies.
Kindred.escape: Even if Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down, wait to engage if Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy is still available. Close the distance with Gragas E Body Slam before W comes back, and if Kindred R Lamb’s Respite creates its zone, use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock Kindred out of it.
Kindred.phase: Kindred is vulnerable to pressure early, so track her jungle path with vision and delay her from claiming marks. Gragas’s burst grows stronger in the mid game, and in the late game he focuses on burst and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
Kindred.teamfight: Kindred keeps moving and attacking in Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy, so look for an angle to knock her out of the zone with Gragas R Explosive Cask. When Kindred R Lamb’s Respite is active, enter the zone so low-health allies can survive; if you have a chance to kill Kindred, knock her out of the zone with R. Before engaging, make sure your allies are close enough to follow. Knock enemies airborne with Gragas E Body Slam and Q Barrel Roll, then split the formation with R.

Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage to isolated targets, so stay near allies or minions. When Kha'Zix leaves vision, watch for the bonus damage and slow on attacks empowered by Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat, and secure vision in bushes. If Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix R Void Assault to stealth, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along his likely approach path and control him as soon as he reappears.
Khazix.build: Build armor first to mitigate Kha'Zix's main damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear, W Void Spike, and E Leap. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat, but it is effective against his other main sources of damage.
Khazix.fight: Stay close to allies to avoid isolation, and wait for Kha'Zix to use Kha'Zix E Leap to engage. Immediately after he leaps, close in with Gragas E Body Slam to knock him up, then detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Use Gragas W Drunken Rage before Kha'Zix's burst damage lands.
Khazix.laning: While jungling, clear camps with Gragas W Drunken Rage's empowered attack and use the healing from Gragas P Happy Hour, which triggers when you cast a spell. When ganking, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy's retreat path first, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they pull back. Avoid jungle routes that leave you alone in positions Kha'Zix could target.
Khazix.combo: When Kha'Zix E Leap is on cooldown, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point while engaging with Gragas E Body Slam. Once E Body Slam hits and Kha'Zix is airborne, cast Gragas W Drunken Rage and reactivate the barrel to detonate it. If needed, land Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Kha'Zix to knock him toward your allies.
Khazix.escape: The moment after Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to engage is your chance to go in. Close the distance with Gragas E Body Slam, then follow with Gragas R Explosive Cask to keep Kha'Zix from escaping. If Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix R Void Assault to stealth, stay near your allies and control him when he reappears.
Khazix.teamfight: Fight grouped with your allies in narrow areas where you have vision to prevent the isolation damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Keep your backline carries near a tank, and respond to Kha'Zix's E Leap engage with Gragas E Body Slam or R Explosive Cask. Before engaging, activate Gragas W Drunken Rage and check that your allies are close enough to follow, then split the enemy formation with Gragas R Explosive Cask.
Khazix.phase: In the early game, look for chances to pressure the jungle and secure objectives before Kha'Zix gets his first evolution. In the mid game, avoid acting alone once Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions. In the late game, Gragas should focus on burst damage and disrupting formations.

LeeSin.watch: Lee Sin can cross walls with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will from areas without vision, so stand away from walls.
LeeSin.build: Build armor first to withstand Lee Sin's main damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple. Since basic attacks and attack speed are central to his damage, reducing his attack speed is also effective.
LeeSin.fight: If you encounter Lee Sin in the jungle early, back off instead of accepting a duel. Before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back up, close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam to knock him up, then detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll to trade damage. When heavy damage is about to land, cast Gragas W Drunken Rage beforehand.
LeeSin.laning: Use Gragas W Drunken Rage's empowered attack and Gragas P Happy Hour's healing while clearing camps, and look for gank opportunities where Gragas E Body Slam can reach. When ganking, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy's retreat path first, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam.
LeeSin.combo: Before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back up, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point while engaging with Gragas E Body Slam. Once E Body Slam hits and Lee Sin is airborne, cast Gragas W Drunken Rage and detonate the barrel. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to move Lee Sin where you want him and make it difficult for him to escape.
LeeSin.escape: Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and W Safeguard / Iron Will are both mobility tools, so don't engage immediately just because one has been fully expended. In particular, look to approach with Gragas E Body Slam before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back up. Before going in, decide whether to use Gragas E Body Slam to engage or save it to disengage.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so back off if you encounter him in the jungle and buy time with objectives and lane advantages. Gragas's burst becomes strong in the mid game. In the late game, focus on burst damage and disrupting the enemy formation as Lee Sin's power falls off.
LeeSin.teamfight: Watch for Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage: don't stand on top of your allies, and keep an eye on the space Lee Sin could use to get behind you. Activate Gragas W Drunken Rage within range for your allies to follow, then knock up the backline with Gragas E Body Slam and detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Land Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation.

MasterYi.watch: Master Yi cannot be targeted while casting Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so aim for the moment he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, the slow from Gragas Q Barrel Roll has no effect. Also watch out for the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style.
MasterYi.build: Resistances don't work against the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, so build health as well. Attack speed reduction lowers both his basic attack damage and the rate at which Master Yi Q Alpha Strike comes back up.
MasterYi.fight: When Master Yi lands after using Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, close in with Gragas E Body Slam to knock him up. Activate Gragas W Drunken Rage before the damage lands, then detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll while he is airborne. If Master Yi R Highlander is active, control the distance with knock-ups and forced movement instead of relying on slows.
MasterYi.laning: Master Yi is weak in the jungle early, so fight him when you encounter him and take early objectives to slow his growth. When ganking, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy's retreat path, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they pull back.
MasterYi.combo: While dashing with Gragas E Body Slam, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point. If E hits, cast Gragas W Drunken Rage, then detonate Q while Master Yi is airborne and follow with an empowered basic attack. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Master Yi when you need to knock him toward your allies.
MasterYi.escape: The moment after Master Yi finishes Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and lands is your chance to engage with Gragas E Body Slam. Since he has already used his mobility tool Q, use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock him where you want him.
MasterYi.phase: The mid game, once you have one or two Ability Power items, is when Gragas's burst is strongest. Master Yi grows stronger in the late game, so focus on burst damage and disrupting the enemy formation.
MasterYi.teamfight: Group with your allies and layer crowd control so Master Yi doesn't get his first takedown involvement. Knock him up with Gragas E Body Slam right after he lands from Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. If Master Yi activates W Meditate, interrupt it with your saved E. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock Master Yi away from your allies or split the enemy formation.

Lillia.watch: If Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed hits you, it applies Dream Dust and can make you a target for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, so avoid letting them hit you. Lillia E Swirlseed is hard to dodge in narrow passages, so when you don't know Lillia's location, don't walk straight through jungle entrances or river passages. If you see the cast animation for Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, move sideways to avoid the center hit.
Lillia.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for magic damage from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough, Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, and other sources. Get some armor for her basic attacks too, but resistances cannot reduce the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows, and Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough scales with your maximum health, so be careful about building only a large amount of health.
Lillia.fight: Dodge Lillia's spells and keep your distance before she can land spells and build up movement speed. Immediately after Lillia uses Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, close in with Gragas E Body Slam to knock her up, and detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll while she cannot move. If you can see Lillia's damage coming, use Gragas W Drunken Rage beforehand.
Lillia.laning: In the jungle, attack camps with Gragas W Drunken Rage's empowered basic attack and cycle through your spells to use the healing from Gragas P Happy Hour. When ganking, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along Lillia's retreat path first, then knock her up with Gragas E Body Slam as she pulls back. Avoid narrow entrances when you don't know Lillia's location.
Lillia.combo: If you can get close immediately, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point while dashing with Gragas E Body Slam. If E Body Slam hits, cast Gragas W Drunken Rage, then reactivate the barrel to detonate it while Lillia is airborne. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Lillia when you need to knock her toward your allies.
Lillia.escape: The moment after you bait Lillia into using Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is your window to close the distance with Gragas E Body Slam. Before engaging, check whether you've dodged Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed, then decide whether to use Gragas E Body Slam to engage or save it to disengage.
Lillia.phase: Your burst is strong in the mid game once you have one or two Ability Power items, so look for chances when Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is on cooldown. In the late game, focus on burst damage and disrupting the enemy formation over sustained damage.
Lillia.teamfight: Save Gragas E Body Slam so you can catch Lillia if she comes in from the flank. When engaging, activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, knock her up with Gragas E Body Slam, then follow with Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to split the enemy formation, but first check that your allies are close enough to follow.

MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so dodge it by staying out of range. If Wukong follows up with Q Crushing Blow after closing in, your armor is reduced. The clone left by Wukong W Warrior Trickster does not move, so do not use Gragas E Body Slam or Gragas Q Barrel Roll on it; watch which direction the real Wukong will retreat.
MonkeyKing.build: Buy armor first to blunt Wukong’s main damage. Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor, so avoid his empowered basic attack and consider attack speed reduction to cut damage that relies on basic attacks and attack speed. Wukong E Nimbus Strike deals magic damage, and Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on your maximum health, so armor or health alone cannot cover all his damage.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong builds up armor and healing the longer a fight lasts, so use repeated short trades and back off. Gragas’s magic damage hits Wukong’s low magic resistance hard. When Wukong closes in, use Gragas W Drunken Rage to prepare for the incoming damage, then answer with Gragas E Body Slam and Gragas Q Barrel Roll.
MonkeyKing.laning: Manage your distance outside Wukong E Nimbus Strike’s range, then take short trades with your early magic damage advantage when he closes in. Save Gragas Q Barrel Roll for trades instead of farming, and sustain with Gragas P Happy Hour, which heals whenever you cast a spell. Gragas E Body Slam has a long cooldown if it misses, so use it when you have a clear chance to hit.
MonkeyKing.combo: Confirm which Wukong is the real one, then place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot while charging in with Gragas E Body Slam. While E hits and Wukong is airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage, detonate Q, then land an empowered basic attack. When needed, place Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Wukong to knock him toward your allies.
MonkeyKing.escape: The window before Wukong W Warrior Trickster comes back is a chance to close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam. Wukong E Nimbus Strike is also a mobility tool, so do not blindly engage just because he used W; account for his remaining mobility too. It is a good time to fight immediately after Wukong has spent R Cyclone, and Gragas R Explosive Cask can stop him from escaping then.
MonkeyKing.phase: Early on, Gragas can win short trades by exploiting Wukong’s low magic resistance. Gragas’s burst is strongest in mid game, as you build one or two ability power items, so engage when Wukong W Warrior Trickster leaves an opening. Gragas lacks sustained damage late, so focus on burst and disrupting formations instead of long duels.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: Do not group with your allies if Wukong R Cyclone is ready or Wukong has disappeared from vision. When engaging, activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam, then detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Place Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation. Immediately after Wukong has spent R Cyclone, pressure a fight or an objective with your team.

Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther it travels, so be especially careful to dodge it when Nidalee is far away, and keep minions or your allied frontline between you. Avoid Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce’s traps too, so you do not start a fight marked as hunted. If you are marked, save Gragas E Body Slam or Gragas R Explosive Cask for when Nidalee uses Pounce to engage.
Nidalee.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Nidalee’s damage. However, stepping out of the path of Nidalee Q Javelin Toss takes priority over resistance.
Nidalee.fight: Just after baiting out Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce’s Pounce, close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam. While E hits and Nidalee is airborne, detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll, and if needed, use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock her to the position you want.
Nidalee.laning: Expect traps at jungle entrances and in the river. Check for them with a Control Ward or an area-of-effect ability before entering. In the jungle, use Gragas W Drunken Rage’s empowered basic attack to damage camps, and cycle your spells to make use of Gragas P Happy Hour’s healing. When ganking, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll on the enemy’s retreat path and knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they back away.
Nidalee.combo: Once Nidalee’s Pounce is down, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot while charging in with Gragas E Body Slam. While E hits and Nidalee is airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage, detonate Q, then land an empowered basic attack. If you need Gragas R Explosive Cask, use it to knock Nidalee toward your allies.
Nidalee.escape: The moment after Nidalee uses Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce’s Pounce is a chance to engage with Gragas E Body Slam. Nidalee has no crowd control, but if you are marked after being hit by a spear or trap, save E or Gragas R Explosive Cask to answer her Pounce.
Nidalee.phase: Your burst is strongest in mid game, as you build one or two ability power items. Late game, you lack sustained damage, so focus on burst and disrupting formations.
Nidalee.teamfight: Remember where Nidalee stepped out to throw her spear. Activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, knock her up with Gragas E Body Slam, then follow up with Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Place Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation, or knock Nidalee toward your allies. Before engaging, make sure your allies are close enough to follow up.

Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up. When you see it, move toward the snowball instead of running away, then leave along the path Nunu & Willump came from. If hit by Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, use Gragas E Body Slam to get out before the delayed root lands. Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero makes it harder to escape the longer you stay inside, so interrupt it with Gragas E Body Slam or immediately leave its range.
Nunu.build: Get Morellonomicon early to reduce the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume. Build magic resistance first to prepare for Nunu & Willump’s main damage, and get tenacity to prepare for the snowball’s crowd control.
Nunu.fight: After dodging Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever!, close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam and fight. If you see Nunu & Willump’s heavy damage coming, use Gragas W Drunken Rage in advance. Detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll while the enemy is airborne and unable to move. Nunu & Willump can heal again with Q Consume, so get a way to reduce healing before trying to finish them off.
Nunu.laning: Nunu & Willump can return soon after a gank, so keep watching for snowballs coming from out of vision. When Gragas ganks, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll on the enemy’s retreat path and knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they back away.
Nunu.combo: Charge toward Nunu & Willump with Gragas E Body Slam while placing Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot. After the collision knocks them up, press Gragas W Drunken Rage, then detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll while they cannot move. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Nunu & Willump to knock them toward your allies.
Nunu.escape: Once Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! has passed and you have dodged the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, engage with Gragas E Body Slam. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on their own, so once you catch them, use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock them where you want.
Nunu.phase: Late game, focus on burst and disrupting formations instead of sustained damage.
Nunu.teamfight: When Nunu & Willump uses R Absolute Zero, interrupt the channel with the knockup from Gragas E Body Slam. Before engaging, activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, then follow up Gragas E Body Slam’s knockup with Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Place Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation, but first make sure your allies are close enough to follow up.

Poppy.build: Build armor first to prepare for Poppy’s main damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about investing heavily in health alone. Do not spend resources on magic resistance just to deal with Poppy.
Poppy.fight: Close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. If you see Poppy’s damage coming, press Gragas W Drunken Rage in advance to reduce the damage you take. Even if Poppy’s health is low, account for her increased armor and check that you have enough finishing damage before going in.
Poppy.laning: Trade in open space, without backing up against a wall or narrow passage. If you step on the shield dropped by Poppy P Iron Ambassador first, you can prevent Poppy from gaining a shield. If you are hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, leave the zone before the second hit detonates.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, charge in with Gragas E Body Slam while placing Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot. While E hits and Poppy is airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage and detonate Q. If you have an angle to move Poppy toward your allies, use Gragas R Explosive Cask behind her.
Poppy.escape: Hold Gragas E Body Slam while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active. The window to engage with E is just after W ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down; you can move Poppy with Gragas R Explosive Cask then.
Poppy.phase: Gragas’s burst is strongest in mid game when you have built one or two ability power items. Late game, focus on burst and disrupting formations instead of sustained damage.
Poppy.teamfight: Check that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended and that your allies are close enough to follow up. Then activate Gragas W Drunken Rage and engage with Gragas E Body Slam. Follow up with Gragas Q Barrel Roll, and use Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation. If you see Poppy begin charging Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of its path.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t engage with Gragas E Body Slam; wait for it to end. Stand in open areas, since Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it pushes you into a wall. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, immediately walk out of the remaining zone. If Poppy charges Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of its path.

RekSai.watch: When Rek'Sai burrows, watch for the moment she emerges with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. Move toward open ground, away from walls and narrow paths, and use Gragas E Body Slam to avoid the knock-up as she emerges. If Rek'Sai hits you with ranged poke, move closer to your allies in case Rek'Sai R Void Rush follows.
RekSai.build: Build armor first against Rek'Sai's main damage. You need health to withstand the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, but stacking only health makes Rek'Sai R Void Rush, which deals damage based on your maximum health, hurt more.
RekSai.fight: After dodging the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, close in with Gragas E Body Slam and trade. Use Gragas W Drunken Rage before Rek'Sai's burst lands to reduce the damage you take. If Rek'Sai Burrows to heal, keep attacking instead of giving up distance.
RekSai.laning: Early on, avoid pushing the lane recklessly because of Rek'Sai's ganks, and don't cross areas without vision alone. Step on visible Rek'Sai Tunnels to destroy them and limit her gank routes and escape paths. When ganking as Gragas, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy's retreat path, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they retreat.
RekSai.combo: While using Gragas E Body Slam to engage, roll Gragas Q Barrel Roll to the landing point. Once E hits and Rek'Sai is airborne, use Gragas W Drunken Rage, detonate Q, then land an empowered basic attack. If needed, use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock Rek'Sai toward your allies.
RekSai.escape: Dodge the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then engage with Gragas E Body Slam after Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down. Rek'Sai can chain her mobility to escape, so look especially for an opening after she has also used Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask then to prevent her escape.
RekSai.phase: Early on, Rek'Sai's ganks are dangerous, so avoid giving up a kill and buy time. Gragas's burst is strong in the mid game; in the late game, focus on burst and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
RekSai.teamfight: Activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, then use Gragas E Body Slam to knock up the enemy backline from within range of your allies' follow-up, and chain Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Drop Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation. Before engaging, check that the enemy's targeted crowd control is down.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the main damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl greatly increases his defenses while active, so it's better to deal Gragas W Drunken Rage's max-health damage after it ends.
Rammus.fight: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl activates, back off and wait out its duration, then unload your damage as soon as it ends. Use Gragas W Drunken Rage's empowered basic attack then as well to avoid reflected damage. Before entering Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range, activate Gragas W Drunken Rage to prepare for incoming damage.
Rammus.laning: In the jungle, use Gragas W Drunken Rage's empowered basic attack to damage camps and keep your health up with Gragas P Happy Hour's healing. When ganking, circle behind the enemy laner, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along their retreat path, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they retreat. If you see Rammus approaching with Rammus Q Powerball, position yourself to fight with minions between you and him.
Rammus.combo: Knock Rammus up with Gragas E Body Slam while placing Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point, then detonate it while he is airborne. Use Gragas W Drunken Rage during the knock-up to follow with an empowered basic attack, but if Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, delay basic attacks and focusing your damage until it ends. Drop Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Rammus to knock him toward your allies.
Rammus.escape: If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is also down, engage and use Gragas R Explosive Cask to move him where you want. If Taunt is still available, wait outside its range.
Rammus.phase: In the late game, your sustained damage is limited, so focus on burst and disrupting formations instead of hitting Rammus for a long time.
Rammus.teamfight: If Rammus rolls in quickly with Rammus Q Powerball, anticipate the expanded area of Rammus R Soaring Slam and back away, then move away from the landing point too. When Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is down and your allies can follow up, activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, then use Gragas E Body Slam and Q Barrel Roll to lock down the backline. Drop Gragas R Explosive Cask between the frontline and backline to split their formation.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, put minions between you and him in advance to block his approach. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents movement and ability use if it lands, so fight outside its range. Give Rammus R Soaring Slam plenty of room when he rolls in quickly, and move away from the landing spot immediately afterward.

Rengar.watch: When Rengar leaps from a brush with Rengar P Unseen Predator, he gains the resources needed to engage and empower his abilities, so avoid paths beside brush when Rengar is out of sight. Empowered Rengar E Bola Strike can root you, so use Gragas E Body Slam after letting it pass. When Rengar approaches with Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt, don't travel alone; stay with your allies and keep your formation together.
Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar's main damage. Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt reduces your armor, lowering the benefit of the armor you've built while it is active.
Rengar.laning: When Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths beside brush and use a Control Ward to gain vision of the brush. As Gragas, damage jungle camps with Gragas W Drunken Rage's empowered basic attack and maintain your health with Gragas P Happy Hour's healing from using abilities. When ganking, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy's retreat path first, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they retreat.
Rengar.combo: After Rengar W Battle Roar is down, engage with Gragas E Body Slam while placing Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point. Once E hits and Rengar is airborne, use Gragas W Drunken Rage, recast Q to detonate it, then land an empowered basic attack. If needed, drop Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Rengar to knock him toward your allies.
Rengar.escape: Let Rengar E Bola Strike pass, then engage with Gragas E Body Slam once Rengar W Battle Roar is down. In particular, if Rengar's resource bar is empty, the risk of him using empowered Rengar W Battle Roar to break crowd control is also lower.
Rengar.phase: Gragas's burst is strongest in the mid game, as you build one or two Ability Power items. In the late game, your sustained damage is limited, so focus on burst and disrupting formations.
Rengar.teamfight: Stay with your allies and hold formation within vision so Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt can't expose your backline. When Rengar engages, confirm he has used Rengar W Battle Roar, then knock him up with Gragas E Body Slam and follow with Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to split the enemy formation and give your allies time to deal with the frontline first.

Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault dashes in and knocks you up, while Sejuani R Glacial Prison stuns you, so dodge sideways when you see their wind-ups. If Sejuani W Winter's Wrath hits you with its first strike, move out of range before the second. Move away immediately when Sejuani and her melee allies are building Sejuani E Permafrost stacks on you.
Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first, considering Sejuani's main damage. Sejuani W Winter's Wrath deals physical damage, so magic resistance cannot block it. If Sejuani's crowd control keeps locking you down as soon as you engage, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Sejuani.fight: If Sejuani's frost armor is active from Sejuani P Fury of the North, deal damage first with Gragas Q Barrel Roll, then use its slow after her slow immunity ends. Once Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, close in with Gragas E Body Slam to knock her up and hit the high-health Sejuani with Gragas W Drunken Rage's empowered basic attack. Use Gragas W Drunken Rage before Sejuani's heavy damage lands to reduce the damage you take.
Sejuani.laning: In the jungle, clear camps with Gragas W Drunken Rage's empowered basic attack and cycle your abilities to make use of Gragas P Happy Hour's healing. Contest early jungle control and objectives so Sejuani doesn't get time to scale. When ganking, circle behind the enemy, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along their retreat path, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they retreat.
Sejuani.combo: If their retreat path is predictable, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll first. When Sejuani approaches or retreats, knock her up with Gragas E Body Slam, then detonate the barrel. For an immediate fight, roll Gragas Q Barrel Roll to the landing point while dashing with Gragas E Body Slam. Once E hits and she is airborne, use Gragas W Drunken Rage, then detonate the barrel. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to move Sejuani toward your allies when needed.
Sejuani.escape: The moment after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used is your window to engage. Check that Sejuani E Permafrost stacks aren't building, then close the distance with Gragas E Body Slam. While Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is unavailable, you can use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock her toward your allies.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, take jungle control and objectives away from Sejuani to delay her scaling. Gragas has strong burst in the mid game, but in the late game, focus on burst and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
Sejuani.teamfight: Check that crowd control such as Sejuani R Glacial Prison is down, then activate Gragas W Drunken Rage and engage with Gragas E Body Slam from within range of your allies' follow-up. Chain Gragas Q Barrel Roll, and drop Gragas R Explosive Cask between Sejuani's frontline and backline to split their formation. This gives your allies time to take down the frontline with a numbers advantage.

Shaco.watch: Watch for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes you have no vision of and around objectives. If Shaco approaches with Q Deceive, keep your back to a wall or face your allies so he cannot get behind you. If you kill the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate, immediately retreat to avoid its explosion and boxes.
Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for the damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, E Two-Shiv Poison, and R Hallucinate. Also build health to avoid the low-health range where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage. Pick up movement speed to help you leave spots where a box may be waiting.
Shaco.laning: Early on, keep the entrances to your jungle warded to prepare for Shaco's ganks and invades. Rotate your abilities while clearing camps to use the healing from Gragas P Happy Hour. When ganking, place Q Barrel Roll along the enemy's retreat path, then knock them up with E Body Slam.
Shaco.combo: After Shaco uses Q Deceive, hit him with Gragas E Body Slam and place Q Barrel Roll at his landing spot. Cast W Drunken Rage while he is airborne, detonate Q Barrel Roll, then land an empowered attack. If needed, use R Explosive Cask behind Shaco to knock him toward your allies.
Shaco.escape: The moment after Shaco uses Q Deceive is your window to engage with Gragas E Body Slam. Shaco W Jack In The Box may be on an approach without vision, so secure vision and clear any boxes before going in.
Shaco.phase: Early on, Shaco looks for an advantage through ganks and invades, so avoid giving up kills, maintain vision, and take objectives. Gragas has strong burst in the mid game. Shaco is weaker in isolated fights late, so focus on burst and disrupting formations.
Shaco.teamfight: When Shaco appears with Q Deceive, focus your fire on the real one with your allies. Gragas can cast W Drunken Rage, knock him up with E Body Slam, follow with Q Barrel Roll, and split the enemy formation with R Explosive Cask. Watch health bar reactions so you do not waste damage on the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate. If the clone dies, retreat to avoid the explosion and boxes.
Shaco.fight: Bait out Shaco Q Deceive, then close the distance with Gragas E Body Slam. If Shaco appears and attacks, activate Gragas W Drunken Rage before the damage comes in, then immediately focus your damage with your allies.

Shyvana.watch: Shyvana is unstoppable while flying with R Dragon's Descent, so do not try to interrupt her engage with Gragas E Body Slam. After she lands, create distance with Gragas E Body Slam or R Explosive Cask. Do not stay in close combat while taking hits from Shyvana Q Emberstrike and W Inferno Aegis.
Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, E Molten Burst, and R Dragon's Descent. Build some armor for her basic attack damage, but avoid relying on a large amount of health alone, since Shyvana Q Emberstrike and E Molten Burst scale with maximum health.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana when her Fury is empty or after her transformation ends and she returns to human form. When Shyvana R Dragon's Descent lands, knock her up with Gragas E Body Slam, detonate Q Barrel Roll, then create distance so she cannot keep attacking you in melee range.
Shyvana.laning: Early on, use Gragas W Drunken Rage's empowered attack and the healing from P Happy Hour to maintain your jungle health while contesting Shyvana's camps and objective stacks. When ganking, circle behind the enemy lane and place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along their retreat path; knock them up with E Body Slam as they pull back.
Shyvana.escape: Save Gragas's crowd control while Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is in flight, then use E Body Slam or R Explosive Cask after she lands. Look for a chance to engage with Gragas E Body Slam when Shyvana's Fury is empty or her transformation has ended.
Shyvana.phase: Early on, pressure Shyvana before she has stacks and secure camps and objectives first. In the mid game, make use of Gragas's strong burst window, but expect to fall behind over time because of Shyvana P Scalemail's permanent stacks. Late game, Gragas should focus on burst and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies are not hit together by Shyvana R Dragon's Descent's path and empowered area-of-effect abilities. After Shyvana lands, knock her up with Gragas E Body Slam and detonate Q Barrel Roll. Use R Explosive Cask to separate Shyvana from the backline so your allies can fight with a numbers advantage.
Shyvana.combo: While dashing toward Shyvana with Gragas E Body Slam, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point, then recast Q to detonate it while she’s knocked up. If E lands, immediately press W Drunken Rage to follow up with an empowered attack. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to send Shyvana toward your allies.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain, and he stuns you if he hits a wall while carrying you. Fight in open space instead of with your back to a wall, and stay alert for his next charge if you hit one. Skarner R Impale's suppression cannot be removed with Gragas E Body Slam or interrupted with a stun, so keep your distance when Skarner approaches.
Skarner.fight: The moment after you bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your chance to close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam. Limit the time you stay close so you do not keep taking empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Cast Gragas W Drunken Rage just before Skarner's damage lands to benefit from its damage reduction.
Skarner.laning: Early on, clear jungle camps with Gragas W Drunken Rage's empowered attack and maintain your health with the healing from Gragas P Happy Hour when you use abilities. Rather than focusing on clearing every camp, look for gank angles where Gragas E Body Slam can reach. When ganking, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy's retreat path first, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they pull back.
Skarner.combo: After Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is used, engage with Gragas E Body Slam and place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot. While Skarner is airborne after E Body Slam hits, cast Gragas W Drunken Rage and detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll. If needed, use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock Skarner where you want him.
Skarner.escape: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is his mobility tool, so engage with Gragas E Body Slam immediately after you bait it out. If you have allowed Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to slam you into a wall, his next charge may come quickly, so account for room to retreat. Keep in mind that if Skarner R Impale is available, engaging with Gragas E Body Slam will not let you escape its suppression.
Skarner.phase: In the mid game, use Gragas's stronger burst to take jungle control and objectives and delay Skarner's item timings. Late game, Gragas should focus on burst and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage, and avoid situations where a well-scaled Skarner can keep surviving and holding you in place.
Skarner.teamfight: Before engaging, check whether Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and R Impale have been used, and whether your allies are close enough to follow. Cast Gragas W Drunken Rage, knock up an enemy with Gragas E Body Slam, then detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Gragas R Explosive Cask can split the formation between Skarner's frontline and backline. Be careful near the edge of the Dragon or Baron pit so Skarner R Impale does not catch you and drag you inside.
Skarner.build: If you need to escape after Skarner R Impale catches you, consider Quicksilver Sash first. To withstand the damage, prioritize magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale.

Taliyah.watch: Do not charge across rocky ground with Gragas E Body Slam. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley cannot change direction while being cast, so dodge it to the side.
Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and E Unraveled Earth. Buy Quicksilver Sash earlier if other enemies also have plenty of immobilizing crowd control that locks you down immediately after you engage.
Taliyah.laning: In the jungle, clear camps with Gragas W Drunken Rage's empowered attack and rotate your abilities to use the healing from Gragas P Happy Hour. When ganking, circle behind the lane and place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along Taliyah's retreat path first; knock her up with Gragas E Body Slam as she pulls back. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, anticipate her using Taliyah P Rock Surfing and R Weaver's Wall to intervene in another lane, and retreat early.
Taliyah.combo: Charge with Gragas E Body Slam along a path without rocky ground, placing Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot. When E Body Slam hits and Taliyah is airborne, cast Gragas W Drunken Rage and recast Gragas Q Barrel Roll to detonate it. If needed, drop Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Taliyah to knock her toward your allies.
Taliyah.escape: Do not engage immediately just because only one of Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall is down. In particular, close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam from an angle that avoids rocky ground before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back. If you keep dealing damage once you are on her, you can prevent her from using her escape ultimate.
Taliyah.phase: The mid game, when you have one or two ability power items, is the peak of Gragas's burst, so actively look for angles to get onto Taliyah. Late game, focus on burst and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
Taliyah.teamfight: Check that your allies are close enough to follow, then cast Gragas W Drunken Rage and hit Gragas E Body Slam along a path that avoids rocky ground, following up with Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Drop Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation.
Taliyah.fight: Dodge Taliyah Q Threaded Volley to the side. Check where Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is placed and the path of Gragas E Body Slam, then engage. Use Gragas W Drunken Rage just before Taliyah’s burst damage lands to reduce the damage. Gragas’s magic damage is effective against Taliyah, who has low magic resistance, so don’t be afraid to trade from an angle where Gragas E Body Slam can connect.

Vi.watch: When Vi charges Vi Q Vault Breaker, its damage increases, so dodge by moving back or to the side. Don’t try to knock Vi away with Gragas R Explosive Cask while Vi is charging in with Vi R Cease and Desist; wait until Vi lands and the knock-up ends, then use it.
Vi.build: Build armor first to prepare for Vi’s main damage. Vi W Denting Blows reduces armor and deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone and consider ways to reduce attack speed.
Vi.fight: Hold off on trades while Vi P Blast Shield is active, and look for an opening after the shield is removed. Don't trade for long enough to let Vi W Denting Blows stack. When Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, engage with Gragas E Body Slam and keep the fight short.
Vi.laning: In the jungle, damage camps with Gragas W Drunken Rage's empowered basic attack and cycle your abilities to benefit from Gragas P Happy Hour's healing. Instead of focusing on clearing every camp, look for an angle to circle behind the lane, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy's retreat path, and knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they retreat.
Vi.combo: When Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, engage with Gragas E Body Slam and place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot. While E hits and the enemy is airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage and detonate Q. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock the enemy toward your allies.
Vi.escape: Vi Q Vault Breaker is Vi’s mobility tool, so the moment after you bait it out is your window to engage with Gragas E Body Slam. If Vi R Cease and Desist has already started, wait until Vi lands and the knock-up ends, then knock Vi away with Gragas R Explosive Cask.
Vi.phase: Gragas’s burst peaks in mid game after building one or two ability power items, so look for windows when Vi Q Vault Breaker is down. Gragas lacks sustained damage late game, so focus on short bursts and disrupting the enemy formation.
Vi.teamfight: Vi R Cease and Desist follows its chosen target to the end, so don't let your allied backline damage dealers leave vision alone; fight within range of protective abilities. Gragas should activate Gragas W Drunken Rage at a distance your allies can follow from, then engage with Gragas E Body Slam and Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation.

Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede quickly closes in and stuns with its first attack on each target.
