Watch for the stun right after Udyr activates it; after being stunned once, retaliate or retreat while you can't be stunned again. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so don't stay in close combat for long.
Udyr.build: Build armor first. Armor won’t mitigate the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both physical and magic damage, so one type of resistance can’t block all of it. Consider ways to reduce attack speed instead of stacking health alone.
Udyr.fight: Bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede, then engage with Gragas E Body Slam after the period when its Awakened effect prevents immobilizing effects ends. When Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield is gone, focus your damage to deny Udyr time to heal. Press Gragas W Drunken Rage before the damage comes in to reduce the damage you take.
Udyr.laning: Place vision at jungle entrances and key paths to track Udyr’s route. Be careful not to push forward in lane while Udyr is unseen. To gank as Gragas, circle behind the lane, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy’s retreat path, and look to knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they retreat.
Udyr.combo: After Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s Awakened effect ends, engage with Gragas E Body Slam and place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot. While Gragas E Body Slam hits and Udyr is airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage and detonate Q. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock Udyr to the desired position when needed.
Udyr.escape: Udyr E Blazing Stampede is a mobility tool, so the moment after you bait it out is your chance to close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam. Apply an immobilizing effect after Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s Awakened effect ends, and use Gragas R Explosive Cask then to cut off Udyr’s escape route. Decide before engaging whether to save Gragas E Body Slam for disengaging.
Udyr.phase: Burst is strongest in mid game after building one or two ability power items. In late game, focus on burst and disrupting the enemy formation rather than sustained damage; the available information isn’t enough to determine how Udyr’s relative strength changes by game stage.
Udyr.teamfight: Instead of trying to burst down Udyr first when Udyr has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle, target weaker enemies behind him. Activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, then use Gragas E Body Slam to knock up the backline from a distance your allies can follow from, and detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask between the frontline and backline to split their formation.

Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw’s stun lasts longer the more it is charged, so dodge to the side when you see Viego charging, and interrupt it with Gragas E Body Slam or Gragas R Explosive Cask if Viego is in range. If Viego E Harrowed Path is visible on terrain, watch for an approach from the mist. When health is low, retreat and beware of Viego R Heartbreaker, which deals damage based on missing health.
Viego.build: Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If a duel with Viego drags on, consider Grievous Wounds next to reduce healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King. Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King adds damage based on the target’s current health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Viego.laning: In the jungle, clear camps with Gragas W Drunken Rage’s empowered basic attack and cycle your abilities to benefit from Gragas P Happy Hour’s healing. To gank, circle behind the lane, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy’s retreat path, and knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam. If Viego E Harrowed Path is visible on terrain, don’t push the lane in that direction; avoid the area or check it with a Control Ward.
Viego.combo: During Gragas E Body Slam’s dash, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot. While Gragas E Body Slam hits and Viego is airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage, recast Gragas Q Barrel Roll to detonate it, then land an empowered basic attack. If you need to move Viego toward your allies, use Gragas R Explosive Cask behind Viego.
Viego.escape: Don’t engage just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down. Your opportunity comes before Viego R Heartbreaker is back up, so close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam when Viego W Spectral Maw is also down or you can interrupt its charge. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask then to knock Viego to the desired position.
Viego.phase: In mid game, Gragas’s burst peaks after building one or two ability power items, so look for an opening to engage without giving Viego a kill. Late game, Gragas should focus on burst and disrupting the enemy formation rather than sustained damage.
Viego.teamfight: Before engaging, check that your allies can follow from your position. Activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, then attack the enemy backline with Gragas E Body Slam and Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to split the enemy formation or knock Viego away from a fallen ally’s location to prevent possession. If Viego has already possessed someone, create distance and hold on until Viego returns to his original body, then counterattack.
Viego.fight: Interrupt Viego W Spectral Maw’s charge with Gragas E Body Slam or dodge it to the side, then engage. If it looks like Viego is about to deal heavy damage, use Gragas W Drunken Rage early, then detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll during the opening after Gragas E Body Slam hits. Back off from small skirmishes where you’re likely to give Viego a kill.

Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, Warwick takes reduced damage and its fear follows, so save your burst and create distance. You can act while suppressed by Warwick R Infinite Duress, and Warwick can leap from farther away than expected when his movement speed is increased. When your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your location, so don’t stay at low health.
Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first because Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress deal mostly magic damage. Armor is also valuable because Warwick deals basic attack damage too. If healing becomes a problem in a prolonged duel, prepare Grievous Wounds with Executioner's Calling after building resistance.
Warwick.fight: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, don’t commit your damage; back off and re-engage after the fear triggers. Press Gragas W Drunken Rage in advance when you see damage coming to reduce it, then chip away with empowered basic attacks. Don’t force a dive just because Warwick is low, when his healing becomes stronger.
Warwick.laning: In the early game, maintain your jungle health with Gragas W Drunken Rage’s empowered basic attack and Gragas P Happy Hour’s healing while watching the lane state. To gank, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy’s retreat path first, then knock them up with E Body Slam as they retreat. If your health drops below half and Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals you, give up some farming and recall.
Warwick.combo: For an immediate fight, place Q Barrel Roll at the landing spot during Gragas E Body Slam’s dash. While Gragas E Body Slam hits and the enemy is airborne, press W Drunken Rage, detonate Q Barrel Roll, then land an empowered basic attack. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to move Warwick to the desired position when needed.
Warwick.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Warwick E Primal Howl’s fear triggers and before Warwick R Infinite Duress is back up. If you engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down, Warwick can escape with R Infinite Duress, so track both mobility tools. When an opening appears, close the gap with Gragas E Body Slam and knock Warwick away with R Explosive Cask.
Warwick.phase: In the early game, take advantage of Warwick’s slow jungle clear to gain an edge through jungle invades and lane priority. In mid game, after building one or two ability power items, make the most of your burst; late game, focus on burst and disrupting the enemy formation rather than sustained damage.
Warwick.teamfight: Warwick R Infinite Duress reaches farther when Warwick has higher movement speed, so don’t assume the other side of walls or bushes without vision are safe distances during an objective standoff. If Warwick suppresses an ally with R Infinite Duress, focus your counterattack on Warwick while he is locked in place. Gragas should activate W Drunken Rage at a distance your allies can follow from, engage with E Body Slam and Q Barrel Roll, then split the enemy formation with R Explosive Cask.

Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot has a visible charge-up, so if you see Zac stretching behind a wall, interrupt him with Gragas E Body Slam or Gragas R Explosive Cask. If Zac gets on top of you, Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on your maximum health, so create distance after absorbing his engage.
Zac.build: Build magic resistance first to deal with the damage from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, Zac W Unstable Matter, and Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Since Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on your maximum health, get movement speed to leave the marked area instead of building only health.
Zac.fight: Right after forcing Zac to use E Elastic Slingshot, close the distance with Gragas E Body Slam.
Zac.laning: In the jungle, chip away at camps with the empowered attacks from Gragas W Drunken Rage and use abilities to benefit from the healing on Gragas P Happy Hour. When ganking, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy's retreat path first, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they back away.
Zac.combo: Dash with Gragas E Body Slam and place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point, detonating it while the enemy is airborne. If Gragas E Body Slam hits, press Gragas W Drunken Rage while the enemy is airborne, and, if needed, use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock Zac where you want him.
Zac.escape: The moment after Zac uses E Elastic Slingshot is your window to engage with Gragas E Body Slam. Follow it with Gragas R Explosive Cask to make it difficult for Zac to escape.
Zac.phase: Gragas has strong burst in the mid game. In the late game, focus on burst and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage. The available information is not enough to say for certain which of Zac or Gragas is stronger at each stage.
Zac.teamfight: Interrupt or absorb Zac's engage with E Elastic Slingshot using Gragas E Body Slam or Gragas R Explosive Cask, then create distance to avoid the area damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. Step on the blobs Zac leaves behind, and use Gragas R Explosive Cask to split the enemy frontline from the backline, giving your team time to clear the frontline.

XinZhao.watch: Dodge the follow-up thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways. If Xin Zhao has hit you twice with the empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, move out of range with Gragas E Body Slam before the third hit knocks you up. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, do not try to deal damage from outside his spear's range; wait for the immunity to end.
XinZhao.build: Xin Zhao's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, but stacking health alone is less effective because Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard deals damage based on your current health.
XinZhao.fight: Right after Xin Zhao uses E Audacious Charge, close the distance with Gragas E Body Slam. Press Gragas W Drunken Rage for damage reduction before Xin Zhao's burst lands. When Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard activates, create distance and counterattack after the immunity ends.
XinZhao.laning: While clearing the jungle, chip away at camps with the empowered attacks from Gragas W Drunken Rage and use abilities to benefit from the healing on Gragas P Happy Hour. When ganking, circle behind the enemy laner, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along their retreat path, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they back away. Dodging the follow-up thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning sideways also avoids the challenge state and the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
XinZhao.combo: Once Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point while dashing with Gragas E Body Slam. If Gragas E Body Slam hits and Xin Zhao is airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage, then recast Gragas Q Barrel Roll to detonate it. To send Xin Zhao toward your team, land Gragas R Explosive Cask behind him.
XinZhao.escape: The moment after forcing Xin Zhao to use E Audacious Charge is your chance to engage with Gragas E Body Slam. Before the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, use Gragas E Body Slam to create distance and avoid the knock-up. You can counterattack once Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.phase: In the late game, Gragas handles burst and disrupting formations. Use the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends as your chance to counterattack.
XinZhao.teamfight: If Xin Zhao looks ready to dive, avoid standing too close to your teammates so his Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard knockback does not split your formation together. Stay within follow-up range of your team, activate Gragas W Drunken Rage, knock the enemy up with Gragas E Body Slam, then follow with Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation, and counterattack when the immunity from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.

Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and slows you, and also resets the cooldown of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, so if Bel'Veth gets close, dodge by cutting sideways instead of running straight back. Bel'Veth takes greatly reduced damage during E Royal Maelstrom, so do not detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll; wait for it to end or interrupt it with Gragas E Body Slam.
Belveth.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. Since basic attacks and attack speed are central to her damage, also consider ways to reduce attack speed. Build health against the true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below sideways, then engage with Gragas E Body Slam before Bel'Veth Q Void Surge comes back. Detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll while Bel'Veth is airborne from Gragas E Body Slam, and do not unload burst damage during Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom.
Belveth.laning: Early on, before Bel'Veth builds stacks, look for jungle invades and skirmishes to steal large monsters and camps. When ganking, circle behind the lane, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy's retreat path, then knock them up with Gragas E Body Slam as they back away.
Belveth.combo: While dashing with Gragas E Body Slam, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point. If Gragas E Body Slam hits and Bel'Veth is airborne, press Gragas W Drunken Rage, detonate Gragas Q Barrel Roll, then land an empowered attack. If you need to send Bel'Veth toward your team, use Gragas R Explosive Cask behind her.
Belveth.escape: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below; the moment after Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is used is your chance to engage. Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has a separate cooldown for each direction, so note the direction she just dashed from, close the distance with Gragas E Body Slam, and chain your crowd control.
Belveth.phase: Gragas has strong burst in the mid game, but Bel'Veth's permanent stacks make things unfavorable in the late game, so focus on burst and disrupting formations.
Belveth.teamfight: Activate Gragas W Drunken Rage in advance, then knock the enemy up with Gragas E Body Slam from within your team's follow-up range and chain Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask between the enemy frontline and backline to split their formation. If an ally falls and Void Coral appears, retreat before Bel'Veth picks it up, and delay the team fight while Bel'Veth is transformed.

Nocturne.watch: If hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, Nocturne can rapidly approach along its trail, so do not run straight away; turn toward your allies or turret. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, you will be feared, so save Gragas E Body Slam to create distance. Do not use Gragas E Body Slam or Gragas R Explosive Cask first while Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active.
Nocturne.build: Build armor first against Nocturne's main damage. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, but the available information is not enough to choose a specific item.
Nocturne.fight: When Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down, trade damage by knocking him up with Gragas E Body Slam and detonating Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Press Gragas W Drunken Rage just before Nocturne's burst lands to reduce the damage. If you need to interrupt Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, save Gragas E Body Slam instead of using it to engage.
Nocturne.laning: Maintain vision around the river and jungle entrances, and position an escape route toward your allies before Nocturne R Paranoia activates. When ganking, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll along the enemy's retreat path, then knock them up with E Body Slam as they back away. Cycle abilities at each jungle camp to benefit from the healing on Gragas P Happy Hour, while managing your mana.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down, place Gragas Q Barrel Roll at the landing point while engaging with Gragas E Body Slam, and detonate it while he is airborne. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, first remove the spell shield with Gragas Q Barrel Roll, then look for an opening with E Body Slam. Follow with an empowered attack from Gragas W Drunken Rage. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask with the right positioning when you need to knock Nocturne toward your team.
Nocturne.escape: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is also down, it is a good time to land the knock-up from E. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is still available, engage with a mobility option for breaking its tether in mind.
Nocturne.phase: Gragas's burst peaks in the mid game, so engage during a window when Nocturne R Paranoia is down. In the late game, focus on burst and disrupting formations rather than sustained damage.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, move toward your allies immediately and do not get isolated. Check Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness, then engage with Gragas E Body Slam and follow with Gragas Q Barrel Roll. Use Gragas R Explosive Cask to knock Nocturne toward your team or split the enemy frontline from the backline.
